topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't believe this is happening. I came out this morning, ready to run my errands, and my car... it's just gone. There's a note on the ground, a ticket of some sort. It says my car was towed. I’ve double-checked; yes, this is my driveway. I've never had something like this happen before. The numbers on the ticket are a blur; my hands aren’t quite steady as I try to read it. I need to figure out what to do now, maybe call someone who knows, but the thought of making that call is weighing on me. How do I even start to fix this?
